Optional: using the official Bootstrap 5 build
==============================================

The application already works completely offline with the bundled
assets/vendor/bootstrap-lite/ files, which implement the Bootstrap 5
class names and behaviours used by this project.

If you would rather ship the official library, download Bootstrap 5
(https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/getting-started/download/ - do this
once, on a machine with internet) and copy exactly two files into THIS
folder:

    bootstrap.min.css          (from the download: dist/css/bootstrap.min.css)
    bootstrap.bundle.min.js    (from the download: dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js)

includes/header.php checks for those two files with is_file() and loads
them instead of the bundled ones. No code change is needed, and the
application still runs 100% offline because the files are local.
